title: Wikidata Knowledge Base Publication and Authorship
summary: This community centers on the 2014 paper 'Wikidata: a free collaborative knowledgebase,' which describes the Wikidata project. The paper was authored by Denny Vrandečić and Markus Krötzsch and published in Communications of the ACM (Commun. ACM). It serves as a foundational reference for the structure and collaborative nature of the Wikidata knowledge base.
key_findings: The paper 'Wikidata: a free collaborative knowledgebase' was published in 2014 in Communications of the ACM (Commun. ACM), specifically in volume 57, issue 10, pages 78–85.
